contents.text: What does error E-303 mean on a CP-200, and does it trip the pump?
Error E-303 means one of the bearing temperature sensors TE-21 and TE-22 reports an open circuit. Error E-303 does not trip the pump.

CP-200 Troubleshooting Guide › 2 Controller error codes › Error E-303: bearing temperature sensor fault
## Error E-303: bearing temperature sensor fault
Error E-303 means one of the bearing temperature sensors TE-21 and TE-22 reports an open circuit.
Reseat the connector; replace the sensor if E-303 returns.

CP-200 Troubleshooting Guide › 2 Controller error codes › Error E-231: liquid temperature high
## Error E-231: liquid temperature high
Error E-231 means the liquid temperature in the casing exceeded 90 °C.
The controller trips the pump after 10 seconds above the limit.
1. The pump ran against a closed discharge valve.
Let the casing cool and find out why the liquid overheated before resetting E-231.

# 2 Controller error codes
Table 2-1 Error codes at a glance
| Code | Meaning | Trips the pump |
|---|---|---|
| E-102 | Supply phase missing | Yes |
| E-103 | Wrong phase sequence | No |
| E-201 | Suction pressure low | Yes |
| E-202 | Discharge pressure high | Yes |
| E-203 | Dry running | Yes |
| E-204 | Flow low | Yes |
| E-211 | Seal leakage detected | No |
| E-217 | Seal-water pressure low | Yes |
| E-222 | Vibration high | Yes |
| E-301 | Suction pressure sensor fault | No |
| E-302 | Seal-water pressure switch fault | No |
| E-303 | Bearing temperature sensor fault | No |
| E-305 | Controller memory error | No |
| E-310 | Communication lost | No |
| E-320 | Emergency stop | Yes |
| E-330 | Clock battery low | No |

CP-200 Troubleshooting Guide › 2 Controller error codes › Error E-204: flow low
## Error E-204: flow low
Error E-204 means the flow fell below 40 m³/h, the pump's minimum continuous flow.
The controller warns at once and trips the pump after 2 minutes of low flow.
2. The process no longer needs the pump.
Open the discharge valve or stop the pump, then reset E-204.
